_comment: A NEW badge is shown automatically for 7 days after an app's latest changelog date (or a top-level date field). The window is NEW_BADGE_DAYS in js/site.js. Future releases only need that date set; do not add the badge by hand. Apps with no date get no badge.

apps.name: Pulse Monitor
apps.tagline: A clean, at-a-glance hardware monitor for Windows.
apps.description: Pulse Monitor detects your hardware at startup and shows the most important live readings on a single screen, with no scrolling. CPU, GPU, memory and drive load sit next to temperatures, power draw and fan speeds, along with top processes and network info. Pick from three themes (Ultra Modern, Retro and RetroAmp), choose which cards to show, and drag them into the layout you like. The app remembers that layout the next time it starts.
features: CPU, GPU, memory and drive usage with temperatures, power (W) and fan speeds (RPM)
Automatic hardware detection at startup
Drive cards with type, used space and read/write activity
Top Processes card, sortable by CPU, memory or disk
Network card with speeds, local and public IP, gateway, DNS, link speed and Wi-Fi SSID
Three themes: Ultra Modern, Retro and RetroAmp
Show or hide cards, pick a theme, and reset to defaults
Drag and drop to reorder cards; window size, position and card order are saved
Low CPU use, and it pauses while minimized
Optional PawnIO driver for full sensor access (the app can install it for you)
requirements: Administrator rights (needed to read hardware sensors)
PawnIO driver for full sensor readings (optional; the app can install it)

changes: Window size, position and maximized state are remembered

apps.name: NeoPlay
apps.tagline: A retro tracker module and audio player for Windows, with modern themes and internet radio.
apps.description: NeoPlay plays classic tracker modules (MOD, XM, S3M, IT and more) and everyday audio files in a FastTracker 2-inspired interface with a scrolling pattern view, VU meters and retro visualizers. It has built-in internet radio with Amiga, C64 and demoscene stations first, plus normal genres. It's portable and switches between the FastTracker, Ultra Modern and Retro themes.

Audio files: MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, OGG Vorbis, Opus, M4A/AAC, WMA
Internet radio with Amiga, C64 and demoscene stations first, plus normal genres, favorites and your own stations
Scrolling FastTracker 2-style pattern view with per-channel mute/solo and VU meters
9 retro visualizers, plus an Off option
Three themes: FastTracker, Ultra Modern and Retro (Ctrl+T)
Playlist with folders, drag and drop, repeat and shuffle
Single instance: double-clicking another file plays it in the open window
Always On Top option, zoom, and Full/Half window sizes
Portable: unzip and run, nothing is written to the registry

changes: CFG is now its own button in both Full and Half size and opens the settings as a solid pop-up. The pop-up scrolls when needed and closes with Esc.
Settings are grouped into GENERAL and MODULES. The MODULES group holds the module-only options: interpolation, stereo separation, Amiga resampler, compact pattern and module view.
ABOUT moved to a small button in the title strip. F1 still opens it.
In Half size, PLAY and PAUSE are one toggle button.
The CFG tab was removed from the side panel, which now has LIST, INS, SMP and MSG. An old saved CFG tab falls back to LIST.

Fixed: settings and buttons in the CFG pop-up didn't respond to clicks.
Fixed: mouse wheel scrolling in the CFG pop-up went the wrong way.

Changed: in Half size, the size button now reads FULL SIZE and sits in the bottom right corner, like HALF SIZE in Full size, and the volume bar is wider.
New: NeoPlay remembers where its window was and opens there next time. If that spot is no longer on screen, for example after a monitor was unplugged, it opens centered instead.
Fixed: on a second monitor with a different resolution, NeoPlay could reopen too big. It now sizes itself for the monitor it opens on, and resizes again if you move it to another monitor.

apps.name: NiceBackup
apps.tagline: Simple, reliable Windows backups with full version history.
apps.description: NiceBackup mirrors the folders you choose to a NAS or another drive using robocopy. It keeps older and deleted files in dated archive folders for as long as you decide. Backup sets run on a schedule (they can wake the PC from sleep) or from the tray. A restore window lets you pick any version of any file, and a shadow copy option lets backups include files that are open. Ultra Modern and Windows Classic themes, 11 languages.

Keeps older and deleted files in dated archive folders for as long as you decide
Backup sets run on a schedule — they can wake the PC from sleep — or from the tray
Restore window to pick any version of any file

Ultra Modern and Windows Classic themes
11 languages

apps.name: NeoGrab
apps.tagline: A sleek, modern downloader for YouTube and 1000+ sites, powered by yt-dlp.
apps.description: NeoGrab is a Windows desktop front-end for yt-dlp with the Ultra Modern dark-glass look. Paste a link, pick video or audio format and quality, choose a folder (defaults to the app's own folder) and download with live progress. It fetches the latest yt-dlp from GitHub on first run (plus Deno, and offers ffmpeg), has a one-click yt-dlp update button, and keeps settings in a portable config.json.

YouTube and 1000+ other sites, powered by yt-dlp

apps.name: NeoCalc
apps.tagline: A notepad calculator that answers as you type, plus a full Windows 11-style calculator.
apps.description: NeoCalc is a notepad calculator for Windows: type plain-language calculations one per line and the answers appear as you type. It handles percentages, variables, sums, units, time zones and live currency (for example `10 SEK in USD`, `15% off 400`, `5 km in miles`). A mode menu also opens Standard, Scientific, Programmer and Converter modes, like Windows 11 Calculator. It's portable, and your notes are autosaved.

apps.name: NeoHealth
apps.tagline: Check your PC's health and fix common Windows problems safely.
apps.description: NeoHealth is a Windows health and repair toolkit. Its read-only Check my PC scan looks at system files, crashes, disk health (including SMART for every HDD, SSD and NVMe), Windows Update, network and more, then gives a plain-language summary with a one-click fix for each problem. Built-in repairs like SFC, DISM, a Windows Update reset and a network reset run behind a safe GUI that asks for admin only when it's needed, makes a restore point first and logs every command. English and Swedish, with Ultra Modern and Windows themes.
features: Read-only Check my PC scan of system files, crashes, disk health, Windows Update, network and more
Plain-language summary with a one-click fix for each problem
Built-in repairs including SFC, DISM, a Windows Update reset and a network reset
Asks for administrator rights only when a fix needs them
Creates a restore point first and logs every command
Disk health, including SMART, for every HDD, SSD and NVMe
English and Swedish
Ultra Modern and Windows themes

changes: Check my PC now shows exactly which programs crashed: name and file (e.g. "Microsoft Edge (msedge.exe)"), full path when known, how many times, and when it last crashed.

Each program gets a likely cause in plain words (graphics driver, Visual C++ runtime, .NET error, add-on or plugin, missing DLL, or a bug in the program) with what may help. The faulting module and error code are shown too.
The crash card stays compact with "Show details". The top 5 programs are listed, and "Show all N programs" opens the rest.
The exported report lists every crashed program with path, cause, module and error code.
Programs that stop responding (hangs) and .NET crashes are now included. A .NET crash counts once instead of twice.
Advice depends on the pattern: update or reinstall a program that keeps crashing, or run the System File Checker when many do.
Fixed: log messages from other software (e.g. Dell DDPM) were counted as crashes and shown as program names.
Fixed: the Recent crashes page could show such log messages as program names.
Fixed wording: proper singular and plural in English and Swedish.

apps.name: Meridian
apps.tagline: Know first. Fix fast. Host monitoring for Windows.
apps.description: Meridian watches your servers and services from a single Windows app: ping, TCP ports, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, CPU, disk space, Windows services, SQL Server Agent jobs and log files (local or on network shares), organised in folders with a green/red/grey status grid. Run checks as any saved Windows account, with passwords encrypted by Windows DPAPI. Get an SMTP email and a tray alert when something fails and again when it recovers, with uptime and response-time history.

apps.name: HeicToJpeg
apps.tagline: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPEG, keeping rotation, EXIF and dates.

apps.name: MidiPlayer
apps.tagline: A MIDI player for Windows, with SoundFonts, a playlist and channel meters.

apps.name: NeoDisk
apps.tagline: A WinDirStat-style disk usage analyzer for Windows, with Insights and disk health.
apps.description: NeoDisk is a portable C# .NET 8 WPF disk usage analyzer in the spirit of WinDirStat. It shows where your space went in a folder tree, a file type list scoped to the selected folder, and an Insights panel: biggest files, duplicates, cleanup candidates, old and forgotten files, and an optional cushion-shaded treemap. The location drop-down lists local drives, mapped network drives and NAS shares. A fast NTFS MFT scan runs when you start it as administrator. There is a SMART disk health tab, drag-and-drop, and an Ultra Modern theme by default, with Classic as an option.
features: Folder tree sorted by size, plus a file type list scoped to the selected folder
Insights: biggest files, duplicates, cleanup candidates, and old & forgotten files
Optional cushion-shaded treemap of the selected folder
Drive and NAS drop-down, including mapped network drives (also when running as administrator)
Fast NTFS MFT scan when run as administrator
SMART disk health tab for local physical disks
Drag a folder or drive onto the window to scan it
Ultra Modern theme by default, or Classic (follows Windows light/dark mode)
Portable: unzip and run, nothing is written to the registry
requirements: Self-contained zip: nothing else to install
apps.run: Unzip and run NeoDisk/NeoDisk.exe. There is no installer.

changes: Removed all preset NAS server names: the NAS server list is empty by default and the 1.1 config migration no longer adds a server; servers already in `config.json` are kept.
Help texts, tooltips, README, tests, demo data and screenshots use generic placeholders (`\\NAS\share`, `net view \\NAS`, `\\MediaServer`).
Copyright and assembly metadata now read "NeoApps".
`CHANGELOG.md` added.

Full ControlTemplates for ContextMenu, MenuItem (TopLevelHeader, TopLevelItem, SubmenuHeader, SubmenuItem) and Separator in Ultra Modern and Classic: no more light icon gutter, separator line or light icon box from the default Aero2 template.

Themed menus everywhere (implicit styles), with rounded corners, a shadow, consistent hover, muted input-gesture text, accent check marks and submenu arrows; covers the TextBox Cut/Copy/Paste menu too.
Self-test checks the menu templates in both themes; new `--context-menu` screenshot mode and context-menu screenshots.
File types follow the selected folder (tree, treemap or Insights), with the folder in the header; computed in the background for big folders and cached.

New Insights panel replaces the treemap: Biggest files, Duplicates (size → partial hash → full SHA-256, background with progress/cancel, Recycle Bin), Cleanup candidates with safety notes, Old & forgotten, and the treemap as an optional tab.

Mapped network drives are listed when NeoDisk runs as administrator (registry, WNetEnumResource and `net use`), shown Explorer-style with a network icon and scanned via the UNC path when the letter isn't available.
Last-access times in the scanner, MFT reader and scan cache (cache format 2; 1.0 caches still load).
New Insights settings (duplicate minimum size and threads, "old" age and size, use last access).
Smaller self-contained build (unused runtime files left out: 66.1 → 57.2 MB) plus a framework-dependent build; the zips include the screenshots folder.
First release: portable WPF disk usage analyzer for Windows with a folder tree, file type list and cushion-shaded squarified treemap, linked selection.
Fast NTFS MFT scan as administrator, parallel standard and network scans, drag and drop, saved locations and NAS share discovery.
Instant reopen from a cached last scan; delete to the Recycle Bin, open in Explorer, copy path.
Disk health page with SMART/NVMe data (code from NeoHealth).
Ultra Modern and Classic (Windows 11, light/dark, accent colour) themes; settings in a portable `config.json`.
